title: QuickHomes
description: QuickHomes is a robust Minecraft plugin that manages player homes with seamless MySQL and YAML storage. It ensures data backup, automatic failover, and synchronization across multiple Minecraft versions for reliable, fast teleportation.
body:
**QuickHomes** ✨🏠  
Take your Minecraft server to the next level with QuickHome, the all-in-one home management plugin designed for performance, reliability, and flexibility!

Effortlessly set, teleport to, and manage multiple homes with ultra-fast commands ⚡️. Whether you’re a casual player or a hardcore adventurer, QuickHome makes traveling across your worlds simple and enjoyable. Enjoy a smooth experience with support for all Minecraft versions from 1.18 up to 1.21.5 🛠️, so everyone can join the fun, no matter their client.

Your data is always safe thanks to dual MySQL & YAML storage options 🔒. QuickHome automatically backs up your homes and syncs them between storage systems 🔄, ensuring you never lose your progress-even if your database goes down. Rest easy knowing your players’ homes are protected!

QuickHome is 100% compatible with LuckPerms 🛡️, the leading permissions plugin. Easily customize the home limit for every group you create-give VIPs more homes, restrict new players, or set unique limits for each rank. Full flexibility, fully integrated! 🎚️  
👉 [Download LuckPerms here](https://luckperms.net/download)

Packed with features, QuickHome offers:  
- Blazing fast teleportation 🚀  
- Automatic backups and failover for peace of mind 💾  
- Easy-to-use commands and intuitive permissions  
- Seamless integration with LuckPerms for advanced home limits  
- Support for the latest Minecraft server versions  
- Clean, reliable, and lag-free performance

Make your server adventures easier, safer, and more fun for everyone.  
**QuickHomes** - the smart choice for every Minecraft community! 🎉🌍
